purpose: Clinical research to improve public health planning.
question: For adults with kidney disease, report latest eGFR counts and means per hospital.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Use the latest eGFR (LOINC 62238-1) per patient.
Report per hospital: adults with kidney disease who have a eGFR value and their mean eGFR, one decimal.
